item.description:
The floofiest of boys
Got this grooming comb
It works very well.
Frank had to give it a stress test.
Both sides!

Frank demanded to inspect it.
Then he grabbed it and ran off and proceeded to claim it as his.
We got it back and the Frank Floof is put away. And here he is all sleek and groomed.
